evals.prompt: Set up GitHub Actions for my TypeScript React project. I need: lint with ESLint, type check, run Vitest tests with coverage, build, and deploy to Vercel on push to main. PRs should only run lint+test+build.
evals.expected_output: CI workflow with parallel lint/typecheck/test jobs, build job, and CD workflow for Vercel deploy on main

evals.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions pipeline for my Python Django app. It should run ruff linting, pytest with PostgreSQL service container, and deploy to a VPS via SSH on push to main.
evals.expected_output: CI workflow with ruff, pytest using Postgres service, and CD workflow with SSH deploy
